summary: Frontend visibility tests for Kunde/Mitarbeiter Hub + Admin User-Editor toggles. 4/5 PASS. One regression found: Finance & Dokumentenverwaltung toggles never render for Mitarbeiter in Admin user edit modal because they are nested inside the kunde-only App-Berechtigungen wrapper.

ui_bugs.issue: Finance & Dokumentenverwaltung toggles do NOT appear when editing a Mitarbeiter (e.g. Anna Weber / ma1@test.com). They are wrapped inside the parent App-Berechtigungen <div> at line 1526 which renders only when formData.role === 'kunde'. The inner formData.role !== 'kunde' checks at lines 1801 and 1824 are therefore unreachable.

test_results.kunde_hub_no_crash: PASS – /hub renders for kunde@test.com without blank screen or console errors. Body contains only header (Test Kunde, Kunde, Abmelden), 'Willkommen, Test!', single Energy Monitoring tile and footer. No Stempeln/Resturlaub/Überstunden/Meine Einsätze/Team Chat/Mitarbeiter-Daten/FAQ/Aufgaben/Info-Karte present.
test_results.mitarbeiter_hub_regression: PASS – /hub for ma1@test.com shows time-clock slider ('Zum Einstempeln schieben'), HEUTE/DIESE WOCHE counters, LETZTE STEMPELUNGEN, RESTURLAUB, ÜBERSTUNDEN, MEINE EINSÄTZE, Team Chat tile, Mitarbeiter-Daten tile, FAQ tile, Aufgaben panel and other module tiles (Aufträge, Einsatzplanung, Verwaltung, Power Monitoring, Energy Monitoring, Geräte, FileShare, Serviceplan).
test_results.admin_kunde_edit: PASS – Editing Test Kunde (kunde@test.com) modal shows App-Berechtigungen with FileShare, Generator-Monitoring, Energy Monitoring (+ Messkoffer selector, Verfügbare Messdaten Zeitraum, Konto-Verfügbarkeit). Finance and Dokumentenverwaltung toggles are NOT shown – correct.
test_results.admin_mitarbeiter_edit_regression: FAIL – Editing Anna Weber (ma1@test.com) modal shows Hub-Kacheln (Module), ADR-Toggle and Sonderberechtigungen → Abrechnung. Finance and Dokumentenverwaltung toggles are MISSING. Expected: both visible.

rca_of_the_issue: AdminPage.js line 1526 wraps the entire App-Berechtigungen section (lines 1526–1798 including its closing) with {formData.role === 'kunde' && (...)} but Finance (1800–1821) and Dokumentenverwaltung (1823–1844) blocks are placed INSIDE that wrapper. Their own {formData.role !== 'kunde'} guard is therefore unreachable. Fix: move the Finance and Dokumentenverwaltung blocks OUT of the kunde-only wrapper (place them after the closing of the parent kunde wrapper, around line ~1798/1798+1, before/after the Hub-Kacheln logic but rendered for any non-kunde role) OR change the parent wrapper logic so Finance/Dokumentenverwaltung remain rendered for non-kunde roles.
reproduction_steps: 4. Click pencil (edit) icon on Anna Weber row
5. Scroll the modal – observe no Finance / Dokumentenverwaltung toggles anywhere
Expected: Both toggles visible. Actual: Both missing.
action_items: FIX HIGH: Move Finance and Dokumentenverwaltung toggle blocks OUT of the {formData.role === 'kunde' && ...} App-Berechtigungen wrapper in AdminPage.js so they render for Mitarbeiter (and other non-kunde roles).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPage.js is 2176 lines – consider splitting into smaller components (user-editor modal alone is ~700 lines).
Dead-code guard: lines 1801 and 1824 use formData.role !== 'kunde' but are inside a parent wrapper requiring role === 'kunde'. Always false.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Kunde-Hub and Mitarbeiter-Hub visibility are GREEN. Admin user-edit modal for Kunde role is GREEN. Only failing scenario: Finance/Dokumentenverwaltung toggles for non-kunde users are not rendered due to nesting bug at AdminPage.js line 1526 wrapping lines 1800-1844. Use evaluate() to read text from fixed-positioned overlay div (no role='dialog' attribute) for modal content checks.
